image_token.reason: Native Florence2 replaces placeholder tokens by masked scatter, so the image token only needs a unique id whose embedding is discarded. Reusing the existing <mask> keeps every tensor shape identical; appending a new <image> row would resize shared/lm_head 51289->51290 and violate the shape-preservation gate.

dropped.reason: native lm_head is nn.Linear(bias=False); no such parameter. Verified all-zero.
tie_word_embeddings=true, so from_pretrained ties lm_head to shared. The legacy runtime discarded this tensor at load; dropping reproduces that exactly.

transposed.reason: legacy stores a raw (in_features,out_features) matrix; nn.Linear.weight is (out_features,in_features)

pos_idx_to_embed.action: value carried from the checkpoint, not regenerated
